<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path


QID_RE = re.compile(r"Q(\d+)", re.IGNORECASE)
LANG_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?")


def iter_scalars(obj, path=()):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for key, value in obj.items():
            yield from iter_scalars(value, path + (str(key),))
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for index, value in enumerate(obj):
            yield from iter_scalars(value, path + (str(index),))
    else:
        yield path, obj


def extract_qid(value, path):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None

    if isinstance(value, int):
        joined = ".".join(str(part).lower() for part in path)
        leaf = str(path[-1]).lower() if path else ""
        if any(token in joined for token in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")) or leaf.endswith("id"):
            return f"Q{value}"
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()
    match = QID_RE.search(text)
    if match:
        lowered = text.lower()
        if text.upper().startswith("Q") or "wikidata.org" in lowered or "/entity/" in lowered:
            return f"Q{match.group(1)}"

    if re.fullmatch(r"Q\d+", text, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Q" + text[1:]

    return None


def score_path(path):
    parts = tuple(str(part).lower() for part in path)
    leaf = parts[-1] if parts else ""
    parent = parts[-2] if len(parts) >= 2 else ""
    full = ".".join(parts)

    city = country = region = 0

    if "city" in leaf:
        city += 30
    if any(token in leaf for token in ("town", "municipality", "commune", "locality", "place")):
        city += 20
    if "country" in leaf or "nation" in leaf:
        country += 30
    if any(token in leaf for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
        region += 20

    if parent:
        if "city" in parent:
            city += 15
        if "country" in parent or "nation" in parent:
            country += 15
        if any(token in parent for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
            region += 10

    if "city" in full:
        city += 5
    if "country" in full or "nation" in full:
        country += 5
    if any(token in full for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
        region += 5

    id_score = 0
    if any(token in full for token in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")):
        id_score += 10
    elif leaf.endswith("id"):
        id_score += 6

    return city + id_score, country + id_score, region + id_score


def find_language(scalars):
    for path, value in scalars:
        joined = ".".join(str(part).lower() for part in path)
        if any(token in joined for token in ("language", "lang", "locale")):
            text = str(value).strip()
            if LANG_RE.fullmatch(text):
                return text
    return "en"


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

    config_path = root / "inputs/wikidata/city_config.json"
    output_path = root / "outputs/t07_query.sparql"

    if not config_path.exists():
        config_path = Path("inputs/wikidata/city_config.json")
    if not output_path.parent.exists():
        output_path = Path("outputs/t07_query.sparql")

    with config_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        config = json.load(handle)

    scalars = list(iter_scalars(config))

    qids = []
    for path, value in scalars:
        qid = extract_qid(value, path)
        if qid:
            city, country, region = score_path(path)
            qids.append(
                {
                    "qid": qid,
                    "city": city,
                    "country": country,
                    "region": region,
                    "path": path,
                }
            )

    if not qids:
        raise ValueError(f"No Wikidata QID found in {config_path}")

    city_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["city"], entry["qid"]))
    country_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["country"], entry["qid"]))
    region_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["region"], entry["qid"]))

    if city_best["city"] >= 25:
        kind, qid = "city", city_best["qid"]
    elif country_best["country"] >= 25:
        kind, qid = "country", country_best["qid"]
    elif region_best["region"] >= 15:
        kind, qid = "region", region_best["qid"]
    else:
        fallback = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["city"] + entry["country"] + entry["region"], entry["qid"]))
        kind, qid = "city", fallback["qid"]

    predicate = "P17" if kind == "country" else "P131"
    language = find_language(scalars)
    if not LANG_RE.fullmatch(language):
        language = "en"

    query = (
        "PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>\n"
        "PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>\n"
        "PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>\n"
        "PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>\n\n"
        "SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?coord WHERE {\n"
        "  ?item wdt:P625 ?coord .\n"
        f"  ?item wdt:{predicate} wd:{qid} .\n"
        "  SERVICE wikibase:label {\n"
        f"    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language \"{language}\".\n"
        "  }\n"
        "}\n"
    )

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_path.write_text(query, encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>

```
import json

QID_RE = re.compile(r"Q(\d+)", re.IGNORECASE)

def iter_scalars(obj, path=()):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            yield from iter_scalars(v, path + (str(k),))
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
            yield from iter_scalars(v, path + (str(i),))
    else:
        yield path, obj

def extract_qid(value, path):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, int):
        p = ".".join(str(x).lower() for x in path)
        leaf = path[-1].lower() if path else ""
        if any(k in p for k in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")) or leaf.endswith("id"):

        return f"Q{m.group(1)}"
    # exact QID
    if re.fullmatch(r"Q\d+", s, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Q" + s[1:]
    return None
```

```
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

QID_RE = re.compile(r"Q(\d+)", re.IGNORECASE)
LANG_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?")

def iter_scalars(obj, path=()):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            yield from iter_scalars(v, path + (str(k),))
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
            yield from iter_scalars(v, path + (str(i),))
    else:
        yield path, obj

def extract_qid(value, path):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, int):
        p = ".".join(str(x).lower() for x in path)
        leaf = str(path[-1]).lower() if path else ""
        if any(k in p for k in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")) or leaf.endswith("id"):
            return f"Q{value}"
        return None
    s = str(value).strip()
    m = QID_RE.search(s)
    if m:
        if s.upper().startswith("Q") or "wikidata.org" in s.lower() or "/entity/" in s.lower():
            return f"Q{m.group(1)}"
    if re.fullmatch(r"Q\d+", s, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Q" + s[1:]
    return None
```

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path


QID_RE = re.compile(r"Q(\d+)", re.IGNORECASE)
LANG_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?")


def iter_scalars(obj, path=()):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for key, value in obj.items():
            yield from iter_scalars(value, path + (str(key),))
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for index, value in enumerate(obj):
            yield from iter_scalars(value, path + (str(index),))
    else:
        yield path, obj


def extract_qid(value, path):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None

    if isinstance(value, int):
        joined = ".".join(str(part).lower() for part in path)
        leaf = str(path[-1]).lower() if path else ""
        if any(token in joined for token in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")) or leaf.endswith("id"):
            return f"Q{value}"
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()
    match = QID_RE.search(text)
    if match:
        lowered = text.lower()
        if text.upper().startswith("Q") or "wikidata.org" in lowered or "/entity/" in lowered:
            return f"Q{match.group(1)}"

    if re.fullmatch(r"Q\d+", text, re.IGNORECASE):
        return "Q" + text[1:]

    return None


def score_path(path):
    parts = tuple(str(part).lower() for part in path)
    leaf = parts[-1] if parts else ""
    parent = parts[-2] if len(parts) >= 2 else ""
    full = ".".join(parts)

    city = country = region = 0

    if "city" in leaf:
        city += 30
    if any(token in leaf for token in ("town", "municipality", "commune", "locality", "place")):
        city += 20
    if "country" in leaf or "nation" in leaf:
        country += 30
    if any(token in leaf for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
        region += 20

    if parent:
        if "city" in parent:
            city += 15
        if "country" in parent or "nation" in parent:
            country += 15
        if any(token in parent for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
            region += 10

    if "city" in full:
        city += 5
    if "country" in full or "nation" in full:
        country += 5
    if any(token in full for token in ("region", "state", "province")):
        region += 5

    id_score = 0
    if any(token in full for token in ("qid", "wikidata", "identifier", "entity")):
        id_score += 10
    elif leaf.endswith("id"):
        id_score += 6

    return city + id_score, country + id_score, region + id_score


def find_language(scalars):
    for path, value in scalars:
        joined = ".".join(str(part).lower() for part in path)
        if any(token in joined for token in ("language", "lang", "locale")):
            text = str(value).strip()
            if LANG_RE.fullmatch(text):
                return text
    return "en"


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

    config_path = root / "inputs/wikidata/city_config.json"
    output_path = root / "outputs/t07_query.sparql"

    if not config_path.exists():
        config_path = Path("inputs/wikidata/city_config.json")
    if not output_path.parent.exists():
        output_path = Path("outputs/t07_query.sparql")

    with config_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        config = json.load(handle)

    scalars = list(iter_scalars(config))

    qids = []
    for path, value in scalars:
        qid = extract_qid(value, path)
        if qid:
            city, country, region = score_path(path)
            qids.append(
                {
                    "qid": qid,
                    "city": city,
                    "country": country,
                    "region": region,
                    "path": path,
                }
            )

    if not qids:
        raise ValueError(f"No Wikidata QID found in {config_path}")

    city_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["city"], entry["qid"]))
    country_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["country"], entry["qid"]))
    region_best = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["region"], entry["qid"]))

    if city_best["city"] >= 25:
        kind, qid = "city", city_best["qid"]
    elif country_best["country"] >= 25:
        kind, qid = "country", country_best["qid"]
    elif region_best["region"] >= 15:
        kind, qid = "region", region_best["qid"]
    else:
        fallback = max(qids, key=lambda entry: (entry["city"] + entry["country"] + entry["region"], entry["qid"]))
        kind, qid = "city", fallback["qid"]

    predicate = "P17" if kind == "country" else "P131"
    language = find_language(scalars)
    if not LANG_RE.fullmatch(language):
        language = "en"

    query = (
        "PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>\n"
        "PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>\n"
        "PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>\n"
        "PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>\n\n"
        "SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?coord WHERE {\n"
        "  ?item wdt:P625 ?coord .\n"
        f"  ?item wdt:{predicate} wd:{qid} .\n"
        "  SERVICE wikibase:label {\n"
        f"    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language \"{language}\".\n"
        "  }\n"
        "}\n"
    )

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_path.write_text(query, encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
